entries.title: The Factories Act, 1948
entries.searchable_text: the factories act, 1948 ministry of labour & employment labour & employment manufacturing & industrial an act to consolidate and amend the law regulating labour in factories. contains provisions regarding health, safety, welfare, working hours of adults, employment of young persons, and annual leave with wages in manufacturing facilities. general duties of the occupier ensure health, safety, and welfare of all workers in factory cleanliness maintain cleanliness and disposal of industrial wastes fencing of machinery secure fencing of dangerous transmission machinery

sections.title: General duties of the occupier
sections.obligation: Ensure health, safety, and welfare of all workers in factory

sections.title: Cleanliness
sections.obligation: Maintain cleanliness and disposal of industrial wastes

sections.title: Fencing of machinery
sections.obligation: Secure fencing of dangerous transmission machinery

entries.title: The Environment (Protection) Act, 1986
entries.issuing_authority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (CPCB)
entries.searchable_text: the environment (protection) act, 1986 ministry of environment, forest and climate change (cpcb) environmental & ehs chemicals & petrochemicals an act to provide for the protection and improvement of environment and for matters connected therewith. formulates environmental quality standards, emission thresholds, hazardous substance handling restrictions, and environmental clearance mandates. persons carrying on industry not to allow emission in excess of standards discharge emissions strictly within cpcb permissible limits furnishing of information to authorities immediate notification in event of environmental accidents

sections.title: Persons carrying on industry not to allow emission in excess of standards
sections.obligation: Discharge emissions strictly within CPCB permissible limits

sections.title: Furnishing of information to authorities
sections.obligation: Immediate notification in event of environmental accidents
